heroHeadline: June 3 Early Voting Opens with Record Turnout; Seosomun Overpass Collapse Rocks Seoul Campaign
heroSubtitle: Two-day early voting for South Korea's June 3 local elections began May 29 with record first-day turnout of 10.39%, exceeding all of 2022's early-vote total on day one alone. The campaign was upended by the May 26 collapse of the Seosomun Overpass — built 1966, under demolition since 2025 — killing three workers and triggering police raids on Seoul city offices on the first day of voting. Samsung's landmark profit-sharing deal (10.5% of chip operating profits) was ratified May 27, potentially reshaping Korean corporate-labor relations across the chaebol system. President Trump signaled a US–ROK tariff deal is near conclusion.
